Monday 03/29 at 10:00 AM PT (1:00 PM ET) is tentatively open on our side, but a quick heads-up: the US moves to DST on Sun 03/08 this year and Europe moves one week later in March in some years — we've seen overlapping weeks where the hour offset is different than typical. To avoid surprises, can you confirm the timezone your London attendees will use? Alternatively, we can propose two windows that work for both US and EU participants:
- 2026-03-29 08:00 AM PT / 11:00 AM ET / 4:00 PM BST
- 2026-03-29 01:00 PM PT / 4:00 PM ET / 9:00 PM BST (later for EU)
